principles: Ground humour in historical fact before adding fictional extensions
Keep CRM-facing fields professional enough for client demos
Use tongue-in-cheek business language rather than slapstick
Mark wholly invented personas and events clearly
Prefer witty understatement over overt criminal glorification

examples.good: Seasoned highway operations consultant with expertise in rapid route optimisation.
examples.bad: The most feared robber who ever held up a coach with a silly grin.
examples.reason: Professional framing preserves demo credibility while nodding to legend.

examples.good: Rose and Crown Hospitality Group — premium coaching inn services since 1735.
examples.bad: The dodgy pub where Dick hid from the law lol.
examples.reason: Organisation names should read as plausible business entities.
